motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Hover, focus, selection, and inline expansion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action on a workflow surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background:#E8FF47; color:#0C0C0C; border:1px solid #E8FF47; border-radius:0; padding:12px 20px; font:600 13px 'Fira Code',monospace; transition:background 180ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#F0FF78; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #E8FF47; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Evidence Row
components.description: Scanner, capability, and diff evidence with an adjacent action.
components.css: .ds-evidence { display:grid; grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto; gap:12px; align-items:center; background:#161616; color:#EDEDED; border:1px solid #2A2A2A; padding:12px 16px; font:12px 'Fira Code',monospace; } .ds-evidence strong { color:#FFAA2C; } .ds-evidence button { background:transparent; color:#E8FF47; border:1px solid #3F461D; padding:8px 10px; } .ds-evidence button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #E8FF47; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-input { width:100%; background:#0C0C0C; color:#EDEDED; border:1px solid #2A2A2A; border-radius:0; padding:10px 12px; font:12px 'Fira Code',monospace; } .ds-input:hover { border-color:#474747; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #E8FF47; outline-offset:1px; }

narrative.overview: A dark-first technical work surface with squared geometry, clear rules, terse labels, and one rare acid-lime control signal. Evidence is dense but ordered; routine configuration is quiet.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Acid lime occupies less than ten percent of a workflow screen.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: A surface earns separation through function and a complete border.

dos: Do show the exact affected object behind every status.
Do keep remediation adjacent to the finding it resolves.
donts: Don't use decorative glassmorphism or neon cyber-security styling.
